frame.physical_scale: One common world/pixel scale calibrated to the existing female SOUTH head width, including ears, at alpha>128. Authored family-scale choice, not a recovered native height.
frame.units: width and center_x are Qud cell-width units (2/3 world); height and center_z are world units. No per-facing rescale.

native_facts: Horns575, paired grooved bone natural equipment on Head288/0. Native data does not specify skull coordinates.
user_interpretation: Symmetric sheep/ram-like grooved horns; preserve this selected interpretation rather than replace it with straight spikes.
root: Paired broad roots at upper anterior crown near forehead; bases widen gradually into the same complete skull-intersecting volume.
curl: User ram photo guides sweep backward around lateral ear region, down and forward, then short upward tip near lower cheek. Human head/ears remain original; photo is not native anatomy.

skull_proxy.meaning: Authored ellipsoid fitted to existing S/E/N head contours, not native skull coordinates. Used for item/body depth only; original head pixels remain authoritative.

projection.camera: Orthographic 11.52 Blender units high,100pixels/unit,768x1152. No independent bounds fit.

views.south: Paired upper forehead roots, broad descending curls beside skull and forward tips; inspect overlap with unchanged flesh ears.
views.east: Wide root above forehead sweeps backward around ear then down/forward into an upward point near lower cheek; no root at back of skull.
views.north: Anterior roots occluded by skull, posterior sweep nearest, forward tips behind skull where appropriate; never paste a frontal curl.
views.west: Opposite orthographic view of the same symmetric volume; fixed original west body.

gates: Check complete manual views and root/return closeups before refinement.
Fresh independent review after each contextual refinement, before extraction or fitting.
Numerical clearance is diagnostic; visible attachment and flow must also pass.
method: Direct Blender normal-based neutral tone regions + Freestyle; no ImageGen
main_review: Pending actual rendered root inspection; no registration/readiness credit.
west: Symmetric geometry; production mirror/ownership still needs review. No separate west output claimed for this trial.
